methodology: Tests used an independent normal Git clone with a real .git directory, exact base commit and required sparse workspace manifests. Initial probes using a Git worktree pointer or incomplete sparse membership were environment failures and are not the baseline result retained here. The final candidate policy is contained in codeql_rust_quality.py, already bound by the proof-to-byte input map.
scope: Python inventory, extraction-contract, macro-coverage, target-profile and publication rejection controls; not a hosted CodeQL compilation, extraction or security-query result
